resources.string: Shows LiteLauncher\'s top bar in place of the status bar in every app

Draws LiteLauncher\'s postmarketOS-style top bar over Android\'s status bar in every app. Pulling it down opens notifications (left half) or quick settings (right half). It reads nothing on your screen and collects no data. Android only lets an app draw over the status bar as an accessibility service.

Android only lets an app cover the status bar as an accessibility service.

On the next screen, open "LiteLauncher top bar" and turn it on. It reads nothing on your screen.

If Android says the setting is restricted (Android 13 and newer, for apps not installed from a store): open Settings → Apps → LiteLauncher, tap ⋮ → "Allow restricted settings", then try again.
Turn off \"LiteLauncher top bar\" in Accessibility settings
